title: New Order
next_chapter_hook: Mr. Mo's voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a solemnity unseen for a thousand years: 'You have witnessed the complete form of the Tianji Record, but do you know... where does the Heavenly Fate Blood in your body truly originate?'

text.content: The moment the bloodline mark on Su Qingyao's brow illuminated, the spiritual energy within the Tianqing Sect Council Hall instantly froze. That mark was like a vertical eye slowly opening, with countless flowing runes emerging from the ethereal blue light—a unique mark of the Fate Writer, the blood proof of one who could peer through Heavenly Secrets in legend.

dialogue.content: 'This... what is this? Chen Ji, what are you—' Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly. She could feel an impulse surging from the depths of her bloodline, as if memories sealed for a thousand years were awakening. Her gaze locked onto Chen Ji, her eyes filled with both shock and a certain sense of relief, as if all mysteries had finally found their answers.

(Inner cold laugh) It seems the Tianji Record's arrangement runs deeper than I imagined. The bloodline of the Fate Writer... interesting. Could fate be sending me a significant advantage? Chen Ji's expression remained composed, as if he had known all along. He slightly raised his hand, calming the restless crowd in the hall.

text.content: 'Everyone, please remain calm.' Chen Ji's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, carrying an undeniable pressure. He slowly walked toward the center of the hall, the humble servant-like aura completely vanished, replaced by a composed demeanor shaped by countless years of strategic planning. 'The establishment of a new order requires your witness.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan sat regally in the sect master's seat, his smile growing increasingly profound. As he watched Chen Ji approach step by step, a subtle wariness flickered in his eyes, quickly concealed by an amicable smile: 'Chen Ji, Chen Ji, throughout your journey, you've hidden remarkably deep. I thought you were the废物弟子 needing protection, but没想到……' He paused, 'Unexpectedly, you are the true chess master.'

'Ling Yuan was overly gracious.' Chen Ji slightly cupped his hands, his expression radiating perfect humility. 'If not for your years of 'protection', how could I have smoothly arranged my strategies in this chaotic world? Speaking of which, I should thank you for accepting me into the Servants' Quarters all those years ago; otherwise, how would I have encountered my destined noble?' As he spoke, his gaze casually swept across Su Qingyao, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

text.content: Ling Yuan's smile froze for an instant, a dark intensity flickering in his eyes. He fully understood the profound meaning behind Chen Ji's words—the 'protection' back then was merely part of his carefully arranged scheme. He thought Chen Ji was a chess piece to be manipulated, never expecting to be the one who had been schemed against. The hall's occupants sensed the subtle shift in atmosphere, collectively holding their breath, waiting to see the next move in this pinnacle confrontation.

dialogue.content: 'Enough!' Han Lie abruptly rose, his entire being radiating a violent spiritual pressure. As the foremost talent of the Xuanwu Sect, he had never concealed his hostility toward Chen Ji. However, when he looked at Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickered in his eyes—that was a loser's reluctance, as well as an instinctive reverence for the strong. 'Chen Ji, stop your mystical pretense! A new order? Do you think one person can uphold the order of the Three Realms?'

text.content: Han Lie's challenge echoed through the hall, and all eyes turned to Chen Ji. This former废物弟子, once despised by everyone, now stood at the forefront of the Three Realms' destiny. Chen Ji didn't immediately respond; instead, he slowly walked to the hall's window, gazing at the churning clouds beyond, and fell silent for a moment.

choice.prompt: Facing Han Lie's provocation, Chen Ji decides:

choices.text: Crush directly, speaking through absolute strength
choices.description: Let Han Lie witness the true gap in power, making him understand what an insurmountable chasm means
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie completely submits, Xuanwu Sect submits

text.content: Chen Ji didn't turn around, only speaking calmly: 'Han Lie, do you know... why you fail every time you challenge me?' He slowly raised his right hand, ethereal blue light gathering at his fingertips—that was the Tianji Record's original power, the materialization of fate's laws.

'Not because you're not strong enough, but because you can't see the direction of fate.' Chen Ji turned around, his gaze blazing. 'I don't need one person to uphold order. I just need you to understand—the price of going against heaven, you cannot afford.' With a light flick of his finger, that ethereal blue light suddenly bloomed, and Han Lie's spiritual pressure was instantly shattered.

choices.memory_label: 韩烈见证了陈机真正的实力

choices.text: Strategic retreat to advance, leveraging momentum to resolve conflicts
choices.description: Utilize Su Qingyao's bloodline awakening and various forces, cleverly defuse conflicts, turn enemies into allies
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie forced into alliance, Three Realms forces integrate
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may submit outwardly but not inwardly

dialogue.content: 'Han Lie, your Xuanwu Sect's proudly boasted Xuanwu Battle Body truly lives up to its reputation.' Chen Ji smiled faintly, then shifted the topic: 'But do you know, during this Demonic Path invasion, had I not pre-arranged things, your Xuanwu Sect's Mountain Gate... would likely have already become ruins?' As he spoke, he lightly raised his hand, and a screen of light unfolded in the hall, displaying the war map from the day of the Demonic Path invasion.

text.content: In the light curtain, Han Lie saw a truth he had never known—that at every moment he fought bloody battles, Chen Ji had been暗中shielding him from lethal hidden arrows. The arrogance on his face gradually solidified, replaced by a complex emotion. Chen Ji continued: "The three realms need cooperation, not infighting. Han Lie, if you still wish to fight, I am ready anytime. But today, I only wish to discuss the new order."

choices.memory_label: 韩烈发现了陈机暗中相助的真相

choices.text: Sarcasm maxed out, exposing weaknesses in public
choices.description: Expose all of Han Lie's dark history and fatal weaknesses, leaving him utterly disgraced
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie was humiliated in public, but his reputation soared

dialogue.content: "Oh? Is Han genius getting impatient?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, his voice not loud, yet clear to every corner of the great hall. "Speaking of which, the last time you challenged me to a duel at Sunset Cliff, you fell into the swamp and couldn't climb out—I had someone pull you out. Do you still remember this, Han genius?"

text.content: A wave of suppressed laughter immediately rippled through the hall. Han Lie's face flushed crimson, veins bulging on his forehead. Just as he was about to explode, Chen Ji continued: "And that time you lost to Ye Qing, being chased down three streets, finally hiding in a female disciple's quarters to escape... Tsk tsk, Han genius's battle record is far more exciting than mine." Chen Ji's tone was nonchalant, yet every word cut to the heart.

choices.memory_label: 韩烈在众人面前颜面尽失

dialogue.content: "Alright, alright, why must young people be so easily angered?" Ling Yuan interjected timely, breaking the tense atmosphere. He rose slowly, his gaze deep as he looked at Chen Ji. "Since Young Friend Chen Ji wishes to discuss a new order, I am quite curious... how do you plan to arrange us?"

text.content: Ling Yuan's question carried profound implications. Everyone in the hall pricked up their ears, wanting to hear what answer this newly risen chess player would give. Chen Ji, however, remained unruffled. He drew a scroll of yellowed silk from his sleeve and unfurled it. Names and force distributions were densely written upon it.

dialogue.content: "Simple." Chen Ji suspended the silk scroll in mid-air, where the characters glowed brilliantly in the Spiritual Light. "The three major sects each maintain their territories with clear responsibilities. The Demonic Path forces fall under Ye Qing's jurisdiction. And Tianqing Sect..." He paused, looking at Ling Yuan, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Elder Ling, with your high prestige, shall naturally continue as Sect Master. However, from today onward, sect affairs will be decided collectively by the Elder Council. The Sect Master will no longer hold absolute power."

Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly, but quickly regained composure. He gave Chen Ji a deep look, his eyes flickering with a complex blend of admiration and wariness. "What a clever case of promoting while sidelining, Chen Ji. Your methods... are more sophisticated than this old man imagined." He clapped lightly. "Very well, I accept your terms."

choice.prompt: Facing Ling Yuan's compromise, Chen Ji decided:

choices.text: Never pursue a desperate enemy; leave room for both sides
choices.description: Know when to stop pushing; don't press too hard. After all, Ling Yuan has operated within the sect for many years. Sudden confrontation might trigger turbulence
choices.visible_reward: Sect stability increases; Chen Ji's prestige rises

text.content: "Sect Master Ling's cooperation, Chen Ji will forever remember in his heart." Chen Ji nodded slightly, his demeanor warm yet hiding sharp edges. "With the new order freshly established, bumps along the way are inevitable. As long as Sect Master Ling is willing to join hands with Chen Ji, the past... can be overlooked." His gaze meaningfully swept over Ling Yuan. "Of course, if Elder has other ideas, Chen Ji awaits at any time."

dialogue.content: (Inner shock) This boy... is more terrifying than I imagined. He's warning me—if I dare have any ulterior motives, he won't show mercy." Ling Yuan's smile on the surface grew warmer. "Rest assured, Young Friend Chen Ji. This old man is advanced in years and long has no desire to compete for glory. Tianqing Sect will eventually belong to the young generation."

choices.memory_label: 凌渊表面臣服，实则暗中蛰伏

choices.text: Press the advantage and settle old scores completely
choices.description: Expose all of Ling Yuan's actions over the years, destroying his reputation so he can never make a comeback
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan completely falls from power; permanently eliminate future troubles

text.content: "Ling Sect Master speaks lightly." Chen Ji shifted his tone, his voice suddenly turning cold. "Since we want to discuss the new order, then Chen must bring up something—for twenty years, who was really behind the Spiritual Mine Incident?" He raised his hand, and another light screen appeared, clearly showing evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with external enemies back then.

The hall erupted in uproar. Ling Yuan's expression finally changed—that was a secret he had hidden for twenty years, evidence of his crimes he thought had long been erased from history. Chen Ji looked at him coldly: "Ling Sect Master, Chen has been collecting this evidence for three full years. Do you think there is still a place for you in this new order?"

choices.memory_label: 凌渊勾结外敌的真相大白于天下

text.content: The atmosphere in the great hall dropped to freezing point. Just as everyone thought Chen Ji would strike a fatal blow to Ling Yuan, Su Qingyao, who had been silent all along, suddenly spoke. Her voice was cold as an icy spring, yet carried an undeniable force: "Chen Ji, that's enough."

dialogue.content: She walked slowly toward Chen Ji, the bloodline mark between her brows still faintly glowing, illuminating her cold features. "The establishment of a new order requires stability, not liquidation." She stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "What you want is peace across the Three Realms, not Ling Sect Master's head, correct?"

Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao, a complex expression flickering in his eyes. He knew she was right, but the long-suppressed hatred in his heart made him hesitate. At this moment, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Master, do not forget your original purpose. The completion of the Tianji Record requires a stable environment. If you start a massacre now, it may attract the gaze of the Heavenly Eye."

choice.prompt: Faced with Su Qingyao's remonstrance, Chen Ji decided:

choices.description: "Su Qingyao is a descendant of the Fate Scribe bloodline; her judgments often align with heavenly secrets. Following her is the right choice."
choices.visible_reward: "Su Qingyao's favorability increased significantly, obtaining the prerequisite for 'Shared Fate'"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan may counterattack in the future"

dialogue.content: "Senior Su is correct." Chen Ji's voice suddenly softened, he looked at Su Qingyao, the coldness in his eyes gradually dissipating, replaced by a complex tenderness, "I almost forgot—my original goal was never revenge." He withdrew his gaze and looked at Ling Yuan, "Ling Sect Master, today's matter ends here. But Chen hopes you remember—Chen Ji's patience has its limits."

text.content: Su Qingyao felt the trust in Chen Ji's gaze, and a warm current surged in her heart. She knew that at this moment, Chen Ji had chosen to believe in her. And Chen Ji felt a warmth emanating from the Tianji Record mark between his brows—a precursor to unlocking the 'Shared Fate' buff. The threads of destiny were binding them ever tighter.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择相信苏青瑶的判断

choices.description: "Ling Yuan's threat is too great; there must be an end today. Personal feelings cannot override public duty."

dialogue.content: "Senior Su, I'm sorry." Chen Ji's voice was low but firm, "There are things I must do." He turned to Ling Yuan, his killing intent rising again, "Ling Sect Master, when you killed my master back then, did you ever imagine this day would come? Chen is not incapable of patience—it's just that some debts, the longer they drag, the higher the interest."

text.content: A flash of disappointment appeared in Su Qingyao's eyes, but she did not speak to stop him again. She understood how deep Chen Ji's obsession was; some knots in the heart can only be truly let go when untied by one's own hands. She simply stood quietly in place, watching Chen Ji walk step by step toward the answer he had pursued for many years.

choices.memory_label: 陈机坚持立场，与苏青瑶产生裂痕

text.content: In the end, under Su Qingyao's gaze, Chen Ji chose to compromise. He knew Su Qingyao was right—a true strong one does not build their power through slaughter. The new order requires balance, the tacit understanding reached through game-playing among various forces, not absolute rule by a single entity. Though Ling Yuan was cunning and deep-thinking, as long as he remained on Chen Ji's chessboard, he could never make waves.

The new order slowly took shape amid this treacherous game of intrigue. The three major sects each performed their duties, the Demonic Path forces fell under Ye Qing's control, and the Tianqing Sect completed its power restructuring under Chen Ji's backstage manipulation. Although Ling Yuan retained the title of Sect Master, he was stripped of real power, becoming thereafter a highly respected figurehead. Han Lie, under Chen Ji's iron-fist policy combined with the carrot approach, was forced to submit, becoming the most unstable element in the new order.

Outside the Council Hall, the setting sun painted the entire Tianqing Sect in gold and crimson. Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, gazing at the distant sea of clouds. Neither spoke, simply enjoying this rare moment of tranquility in silence. After a long while, Su Qingyao softly said: "Chen Ji, do you regret it? Along this journey, what you've lost... is far more than what you've gained."

dialogue.content: "Regret?" Chen Ji shook his head lightly, a relieved smile curving his lips, "I never regret. It's just that if some things could be done over, I wish I could have done them better." He turned to look at Su Qingyao, a hint of tenderness flickering in his eyes, "But being like this now... is not bad either. At least, you are still by my side."

Su Qingyao's face flushed slightly, but she did not dodge his gaze. She reached out her hand and gently grasped Chen Ji's hand. The two hands intertwined, as if the gears of destiny perfectly meshed at this moment. Just then, the Tianji Record mark between Chen Ji's brows and Su Qingyao's bloodline mark both lit up simultaneously, the two rays of light intertwining to form a mysterious rune.

text.content: [Ding—'Shared Fate' buff unlocked! Su Qingyao will become your most loyal companion, and from now on, the Heavenly Fate Value you consume will be shared between the two of you.] The system's notification rang in Chen Ji's mind. At the same time, a familiar voice also came from the Tianji Record—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying a comfort unseen for a thousand years: "Master, the new order has been established, but the mystery of your origins remains unsolved. Do you know... where does the Heavenly Fate Blood in your body come from?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's heart stirred, just as he was about to ask further, Mo Xiansheng continued: "This matter must begin with your father..."

Before the words could finish, a sudden thunder exploded above the Tianqing Sect, fierce winds howled as if some terrifying existence was watching here. Chen Ji猛地 raised his head, only to see in the depths of the horizon, a massive eye was slowly opening—that was the projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the first gaze from a power transcending all toward this newly appointed Chess Player.

text.content: The new order has just been established, the old chess game has yet to end. Chen Ji stood at the forefront of the storm, feeling the gaze of that terrifying eye, an unprecedented pressure surging in his heart. He knew the real challenge had just begun—the complete form of the Tianji Record, the source of his bloodline, his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts, and that Heavenly Dao's Eye transcending all... all the mysteries await him to uncover. And at this moment, the lingering glow of the setting sun stretched his shadow long and long, as if foreshadowing the even longer and more treacherous road he was about to walk.
